subject: science
concept: Understanding the skeletal and muscular systems working together to allow movement
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Function) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student bends their own arm while feeling the muscle contract, connecting it to the bone moving
exercise.pictorial: Student labels a simple diagram showing bone and muscle working together at a joint
exercise.abstract: Student explains how muscles and bones work together to create movement

misconception_flags: believes bones move on their own without muscle involvement

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
